title: Moral Hazard in LTI Dynamics: A Hypothesis Testing Approach
summary: Many incentive design problems must contend with information asymmetries due to non-observation of efficiency (adverse selection) or non-observation of effort (moral hazard). And although a growing body of literature considers incentive design in control systems, the problem of designing incentives for control systems under information asymmetries has been less well-studied. This paper considers a model of moral hazard within control systems. In our model, the control system is described by an (affine) linear time-invariant (LTI) system with process noise.
